usage: pacioliscube [-h] [--version] SUBCOMMAND ...

Validate, calculate, explain and report on a Planning Analytics model tree.
Reads the model and its data, never writes.

positional arguments:
  SUBCOMMAND
    demo       calculate gross margin from packaged synthetic inputs
    validate   report structural findings in a model
    compare    compare two data snapshots using the same model and requested
               cells
    calculate  print the value at one or more cells
    explain    print JSON calculation evidence for one or more cells
    report     print a profit and loss for a year and version

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --version    show program's version number and exit

usage: pacioliscube report [-h] --data DIR --year Y --version V
                           [--format {text,json,csv}]
                           [MODEL_DIR]

Print the group profit and loss for one year and version, at the FY period and
every cost centre. A line that is taken off the result below it, being direct
costs, employment costs, overheads and depreciation, prints in brackets, as
does any figure that comes out negative, so the column reads in the direction
it adds. Each line is rounded to whole dollars on its own, so a subtotal can
sit a dollar away from the lines above it: in the shipped budget, EBITDA less
depreciation prints as 18,684,639 while EBIT prints as 18,684,640.

                        default

  --year Y              an element of the Year dimension
  --version V           an element of the Version dimension
  --format {text,json,csv}
                        output format: rounded text by default; JSON and CSV
                        keep exact decimal strings
